title: Probabilistic Method Atlas
summary: Watch random objects become deterministic existence proofs. One proof machine — random experiment, observable, dependency, inequality, deterministic consequence — runs through eighteen labs: first moment (Ramsey), linearity (tournaments), alterations, second moment, the Local Lemma and Moser–Tardos, Chernoff, martingales, Janson and Poisson, the Rödl nibble, quasirandomness, the giant-component phase transition, discrepancy, ε-nets and VC dimension, entropy, conditional expectation, property testing and dependent random choice. Each lab shows what was random, what quantity is controlled and why the bound implies existence; break its hypotheses, compare it with neighbouring methods, run seeded experiments kept apart from the proofs, follow the proof lens, and present it in deck mode or export narrated beamdswitch Markdown. A concept map, method recommender, command palette and the complete 92-technique inventory with stable ids. URL state, seeds, light and dark themes. Works offline.
